claims.text: Tofacitinib for RA (adults): 5 mg twice daily, or XR 11 mg once daily.
claims.quote: Adult Patients with RA, PsA or AS • XELJANZ tablets 5 mg twice daily or XELJANZ XR (extended-release tablets) 11 mg once daily.
claims.locator: Highlights › Dosage and Administration › Recommended Dosage

claims.text: Before starting tofacitinib, consider TB evaluation (active and latent), viral hepatitis screening, a CBC and updating immunizations.
claims.quote: Prior to initiating XELJANZ/XELJANZ XR, consider performing an active and latent TB evaluation, viral hepatitis screening, a complete blood count, and updating immunizations.

claims.text: Avoid starting if lymphocytes <500 cells/mm³, ANC <1000 cells/mm³ or hemoglobin <9 g/dL.
claims.quote: Avoid XELJANZ or XELJANZ XR initiation if absolute lymphocyte count <500 cells/mm 3 , an absolute neutrophil count (ANC) <1000 cells/mm 3 or hemoglobin <9 g/dL.
Monitor lymphocyte counts at baseline and every 3 months thereafter.

claims.text: Neutrophils: baseline, after 4-8 weeks, then every 3 months.
claims.quote: Monitor neutrophil counts at baseline and after 4-8 weeks of treatment and every 3 months thereafter.

claims.text: Hemoglobin: on the same schedule as neutrophils.
claims.quote: Monitor hemoglobin at baseline and after 4-8 weeks of treatment and every 3 months thereafter.
Perform assessment of lipid parameters approximately 4-8 weeks following initiation of XELJANZ/XELJANZ XR therapy.

claims.text: Tofacitinib: dose modification by indication with CYP2C19 and/or CYP3A4 inhibitors.
claims.quote: dosage modification by indication for patients who concomitantly use CYP2C19 and/or CYP3A4 inhibitors

claims.text: decrease exposure and may reduce or lose response;
claims.quote: Decreased exposure to tofacitinib and may result in loss of or reduced clinical response
Concomitant use with XELJANZ/XELJANZ XR is not recommended
